column1: # Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR), shipped in values-pt-rBR. Drafted 2026-11-05 and decided through the three-vendor debate (l10n/decisions/pt-BR/); ships as beta.
# percent_style has no space, as Brazilian usage and CLDR write it (85%). decimal_style is an example of the separators; pt-BR groups from four digits (1.234,5).
